_comment: Single source of truth for all module repositories. Read by scripts/setup-modules.sh and deployment/docker/docker_deploy.sh. Do not add '_comment' keys inside 'modules' or 'profiles' below — both objects are enumerated with 'keys[]'/'to_entries[]' and a stray '_comment' key gets treated as a real entry.
